dialogue.origin: (こんにちは、相談員役です本日はどうぞ宜しくお願いいたします)
dialogue.content: (Hello, I am playing the role of the counselor. I look forward to working with you today.)

dialogue.origin: こちらこそよろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.content: I look forward to it as well.

dialogue.origin: (時間になりましたら始めさせていただきます)
dialogue.content: (We will begin when it's time.)

dialogue.origin: はい、お待ちしております
dialogue.content: Yes, I'm ready.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは、相談員です今日はご相談にきていただきありがとうございますまずはじめに年齢、性別をお聞かせいただけますでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming in for a consultation today. First, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.origin: 34歳女性です
dialogue.content: I'm a 34-year-old woman.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.content: Thank you. What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.origin: 子供の夜泣きとか、家事とか、とても辛いんです
dialogue.content: My child's night crying, the housework... it's all very difficult for me.

dialogue.origin: それは、とても大変な状況ですねお子さんはおいくつなのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: That sounds like a very difficult situation. How old is your child?

dialogue.origin: 4歳です
dialogue.content: He is 4 years old.

dialogue.origin: 4歳ですか、まだお世話も大変なお年ですよね
dialogue.content: Four years old, I see. That's an age where they still need a lot of care, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: はい、うちの子は夜泣きが本当にひどくて、、
dialogue.content: Yes, my child's night crying is really severe...

dialogue.origin: それは体力的にもたいへんですよね睡眠不足にもなりますしお昼間はお子さんはどのようなようすですか？
dialogue.content: That must be physically exhausting, leading to sleep deprivation as well. How is your child during the daytime?

dialogue.origin: はい本当に大変です昼は幼稚園ですが、毎日行きたくないと泣いて、引きずって連れて行きます
dialogue.content: Yes, it's really tough. He goes to kindergarten during the day, but every day he cries that he doesn't want to go, and I have to drag him there.

dialogue.origin: そうですか、幼稚園に行きたくないと泣かれるとお母さんも毎朝の事ですからしんどいですね
dialogue.content: I see. When he cries about not wanting to go to kindergarten, that must be very taxing for you, especially since it happens every morning.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 相談者さまはお仕事などはされていらっしゃるのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Are you currently working?

dialogue.origin: 今はしていませんしたいんですけど、、
dialogue.content: I'm not right now. I'd like to, but...

dialogue.origin: なるほど、お仕事はしたいと思われているのですね今は子育てや家事に専念されているといったところでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see—you would like to work. For now, would it be fair to say you're focusing on childcare and housework?

dialogue.origin: そうですね、そうせざるを得なくて
dialogue.content: That's right. I don't really have a choice.

dialogue.origin: そうですか、夜泣きがあると睡眠が十分とれないこともあると思われますが、昼間家事をしていて疲れやすいとか何か気になることなどありませんか？
dialogue.content: I see. With the night crying, I imagine you can't get enough sleep. Do you find yourself getting tired easily while doing housework during the day, or is there anything else that concerns you?

dialogue.origin: 家事も辛いです
dialogue.content: The housework is difficult too.

dialogue.origin: 毎日、栄養ドリンクを飲んでなんとかこなしている感じです
dialogue.content: I feel like I'm only managing to get through it by drinking energy drinks every day.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか、とても頑張っておられるんですねそのような状況なら家事も辛く感じてしまうのは当然な状態だと思います
dialogue.content: I see. You're trying so hard. In a situation like that, it's completely understandable that you'd find housework to be difficult.

dialogue.origin: お昼間は家事の合間に、お子さんが帰ってくるまで少し休養をとられたりは出来る状況でしょうか？
dialogue.content: During the day, are you able to get some rest between chores before your child comes home?

dialogue.origin: それが、毎日遅刻していくし、幼稚園はお迎え時間も早くて大して休めないんです
dialogue.content: Well, we're late every day, and the pick-up time for kindergarten is early, so I can't really rest much.

dialogue.origin: 1時間寝ようと思っても、寝不足すぎるせいか眠れなくて困ってます
dialogue.content: Even when I try to sleep for an hour, I can't fall asleep—maybe because I'm so sleep-deprived—and it's troubling.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、幼稚園は預かってもらえる時間が短いですものね夜も昼もしっかり休めない状況でもがんばっておられるんですね素晴らしいです
dialogue.content: I see. The time they can look after him at kindergarten is quite short, isn't it? You're doing your best even though you can't get proper rest day or night. That's wonderful.

dialogue.origin: やるしかないからやってるだけで本当に辛いです
dialogue.content: I'm only doing it because I have to, but it's really hard.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、お母さんのかわりはいないから大変ですよね
dialogue.content: I understand. There's no one to take a mother's place, so it must be very hard.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: お子さんの夜泣きのことなどどなたかに相談されたことはありますか？
dialogue.content: Have you ever talked to anyone about your child's night crying?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: どなたに相談されたのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Who did you consult?

dialogue.origin: 親や親戚やかかりつけ医にも、、でも「夜泣きはみんな通る道」って感じです
dialogue.content: My parents, relatives, and our family doctor... but they all just say things like, 'Night crying is something everyone goes through.'

dialogue.origin: なるほど、そのように言われてあなたはどうお感じになりましたか？
dialogue.content: I see. How did you feel when they said that to you?

dialogue.origin: 愚痴を言う私の我慢が足りないと言われているように感じます
dialogue.content: It felt like they were telling me I'm just complaining and not patient enough.

dialogue.origin: だから、誰にも相談できなくなりました
dialogue.content: So, I stopped being able to talk to anyone about it.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか、それはとても悲しい気持ちになりますね
dialogue.content: I see. That must make you feel very sad.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ご主人とはお子さんのことなど、話したりされますか？
dialogue.content: Do you talk with your husband about your child and related matters?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そうですか、ご主人にお話を聞いてもらったりすると気持ちが楽になったりとかされますか？
dialogue.content: I see. Do you feel better after your husband listens to you?

dialogue.origin: いえ、、、何も解決にも参考にもならないので、、、
dialogue.content: No... it doesn't solve anything or provide any useful advice...

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか、身近にあなたのつらさをわかってくれる人がいない中、本当によく頑張ってこられたと思います。
dialogue.content: I see. With no one close by who understands how difficult this is for you, I think you have done an amazing job persevering.

dialogue.origin: では、今日はこちらでお話して子育てや家事のつらさから少しでも楽になる方法を一緒に考えたいといったご相談ということであっていますでしょうか？
dialogue.content: So, is it correct that your goal for today is to talk with me and think together about ways to ease the difficulty of childcare and housework, even just a little?

dialogue.origin: そうですね少しでも楽になれる方法があるなら教えていただきたいです
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right. If there's any way to make things even a little easier, I'd like to know.

dialogue.origin: では、一緒に考えさせていただきますねいくつかまた質問させて、いただきますが、
dialogue.content: Then, let's think about it together. I'd like to ask you a few more questions, if I may.

dialogue.origin: お子さんは4歳ということですが、性別をお聞きしてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: You mentioned your child is 4 years old; may I ask his gender?

dialogue.origin: 男の子です
dialogue.content: He's a boy.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。夜泣きはいつごろから始まってどれくらいの頻度でありますか？
dialogue.content: Thank you. When did the night crying start, and how frequent is it?

dialogue.origin: 生後半年から始まって、ほぼ毎日です。たまに数日落ち着く日がありますが、月に3〜４日あるかないかです。
dialogue.content: It started when he was six months old, and it happens almost every day. There are occasional days when it settles down, but that's only three or four days a month, if that.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか、それは本当に大変ですね
dialogue.content: I see, that must be incredibly difficult.

dialogue.origin: 布団におろすと眠れないので、朝方までおんぶか抱っこをしています
dialogue.content: He can't sleep if I put him down in his bed, so I carry him on my back or hold him until the morning.

dialogue.origin: はい、本当に大変というか、もう限界です
dialogue.content: Yes, it's not just hard—I'm at my limit.

dialogue.origin: そうですか、お子さんが眠れるように抱っこしてあげているんですねお子さんは安心でしょうが、おっしゃるとおりお母さんの体力がもちませんよね
dialogue.content: I see, so you hold him so he can sleep. Your child must feel secure, but as you say, a mother's physical strength can't hold up under that.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ご主人にお仕事のお休みの日は夜中の抱っこを変わってもらうなどは難しいですか？
dialogue.content: Is it difficult to have your husband take over holding him at night on his days off from work?

dialogue.origin: それが、たまに夜泣きしない日があっても、わたしは眠れなくなってしまっているので、週に1回変わってもらっても、、っていう気持ちがあります
dialogue.content: Well, even on the rare days he doesn't cry at night, I've become unable to sleep myself, so I feel like having him take over just once a week...

dialogue.origin: あと、わたしは専業主婦をさせてもらってるので、夫の休日は休ませてあげなきゃかな、とか
dialogue.content: Also, since I'm a full-time housewife, I feel like I should let my husband rest on his days off.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか、とてもご主人の体調も気遣ってお優しいのですね週一回でもご主人に実際にあなたがされていることを経験してもらうというのは、大切なことだとおもいます
dialogue.content: I see. You're very kind to be so considerate of your husband's well-being. I think it's important for your husband to experience what you are actually doing, even if it's just once a week.

dialogue.origin: 経験してもらう、、、なるほど
dialogue.content: Having him experience it... I see.

dialogue.origin: またあなたがご主人に休ませてあげないとと思っておられるのと同じくあなたもきちんとお休みをとる勇気も大事だと思います
dialogue.content: And just as you feel you need to let your husband rest, I think it's also important for you to have the courage to take a proper rest yourself.

dialogue.origin: 専業主婦なのに、仕事をしている夫に頼っていいのでしょうか
dialogue.content: Is it okay for me, a full-time housewife, to rely on my husband who works?

dialogue.origin: 専業主婦でもお互い大変な状況は同じだと思います困ったことはお互い頼って行くこと自体がお子さんのさらなる精神的安定にもつながるのではないでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Whether you're a housewife or not, I believe you are both in a difficult situation. Isn't relying on each other in times of trouble something that could lead to your child's greater emotional stability?

dialogue.origin: 子供の精神的安定ですか？
dialogue.content: My child's emotional stability?

dialogue.origin: はい、ご両親がお互い支え合って子育てをすることでお子さんも安心して成長出来ると思いますが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Yes. When both parents support each other in raising a child, I believe the child can grow up feeling secure. What do you think?

dialogue.origin: わたしは家のこと子育てを頑張って、夫は仕事を頑張っているのは支え合っているんではないのでしょうか…？？
dialogue.content: I work hard at the housework and childcare, and my husband works hard at his job—doesn't that count as supporting each other...?

dialogue.origin: そうですね、今の状態での十分支え合っておられると思いますただ夜泣きでしっかりと休養がとれないと、家事や育児に疲れてしまいますよね1日でも夜のだっこを変わってもらって、ご主人もあなたのお仕事の大変さも経験してもらうことで、さらにねぎらいの気持ちもうまれるかもしれませんし、あなたじたいも子育てに関わってもらえると安心感も出てくる仮名と思いますが、いかがですか？
dialogue.content: Yes, I think you are definitely supporting each other sufficiently as things are now. However, when you can't get enough rest due to the night crying, you get tired of housework and childcare, don't you? By having your husband take over holding him at night for even just one day, he can experience the difficulty of your 'job,' which might foster a deeper sense of appreciation. And you yourself might feel more secure knowing he is involved in childcare. How does that sound?

dialogue.origin: そうですね、経験してみてもらうというのはいいのかもしれないです　正直、任せられない気持ちはありますが
dialogue.content: You're right, having him experience it might be a good idea. To be honest, I do have feelings of not being able to entrust it to him.

dialogue.origin: ええ、慣れていないご主人に任せるのも不安に思われるのも当然だと思います
dialogue.content: Yes, it's perfectly natural to feel anxious about entrusting this to your husband, who isn't used to it.

dialogue.origin: ただはじめからできなくてもこつをお伝えしながらご主人もあやせるようになると、ご主人の満足感もえられますし、あなたの休養にもなるかもしれないとおもうのですが、どうでしょうか？
dialogue.content: However, even if he can't do it perfectly from the start, if he becomes able to soothe the baby as you teach him the ropes, he might gain a sense of satisfaction, and it could also give you a chance to rest. What do you think about that?

dialogue.origin: そうですね、、、このまま1人でやっているよりは良さそうですね
dialogue.content: You're right... it seems better than continuing to do it all by myself.

dialogue.origin: はい、いつ終わるかわからない夜泣きと格闘するのは大変なことですし、ご自身でもおっしゃっていたとおり、おひとりでは体力の限界がきます
dialogue.content: Yes, it's a very difficult thing to battle with night crying when you don't know when it will end. And as you said yourself, you'll reach your physical limit if you do it alone.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、それが心配で、、
dialogue.content: Right, that's what I'm worried about...

dialogue.origin: ぜひ専業主婦だからと頑張りすぎないないで、あなたが健康でいられるためにもご主人にまずは頼ってみてください。
dialogue.content: Please don't push yourself too hard just because you're a full-time housewife. For the sake of your own health, please try relying on your husband first.

dialogue.origin: そうですねそうしてみたいと思います
dialogue.content: You're right. I'd like to try that.

dialogue.origin: そろそろお時間ですが、きょうはお話されたいことは話せましたでしょうか？
dialogue.content: It's almost time to wrap up. Were you able to talk about everything you wanted to today?

dialogue.origin: そうですね、夫にもっと相談してみようと思いました
dialogue.content: Yes, I think so. I've decided to try talking more with my husband.

dialogue.origin: それはよかったです。是非相談してみてくださいお二人で相談しながらお子さんの子育ての思い出たくさん作ってください
dialogue.content: I'm glad to hear that. Please do talk with him. I hope you'll make many wonderful memories of raising your child by consulting with each other.

dialogue.origin: はいありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: それでは本日はこれで終了させていただきます。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Then we will conclude for today. Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: （お疲れ様でした。勉強させていただきました）
dialogue.content: (Thank you for your hard work. This was a learning experience for me.)

dialogue.origin: (相談者役、おつかれさまでしたありがとうございましたのちほど、評価をよろしくおねがいいたします)
dialogue.content: (To the person playing the client, thank you for your hard work. Please provide your evaluation later.)

topic.sub: 夫との子育ての協力問題
